snapshot.text: State-run, free universal system long known for its doctor numbers and medical diplomacy. In 2026 the health minister said the system was at the brink of collapse because of fuel shortages under the US blockade, with severe medicine shortages.

priorities.title: Keeping hospitals running
priorities.text: The minister warned that fuel shortages push the health system to the brink.

priorities.title: Medicine shortages
priorities.text: Most Cubans report difficulty obtaining medicines; Russia donated medicines.
